name: Iron Shell
desc: Iron Shell operatives must take proactive shield measures to ensure the best defenses against their enemies' common weaponry. Takes %s/%s/%s/%s less damage from beam weapons, scaling on hull size.

name: Zandatsu Subsystems
desc: A highly-experimental and untested combination of Iron Shell's Revengeance defense system and 'Jump' boosters. When activated, the ship system unleashes a concussive blast, reflecting missiles, while the ship itself nimbly lunges in the direction of its current velocity, avoiding ships and weapon fire. Successfully reflecting missiles supercharges the Zandatsu Subystems, boosting their effectiveness.

name: Missile Microforge
desc: A compact prototype missile autoforge. Periodically forges missiles for small launchers.

name: Perfect Vengeance Core
desc:
PLACEHOLDER. This Vengeance Core is perfected. Reflects all missiles in a small radius. Successfully reflecting a missile supercharges the ship's vengeance core, improving shield efficiency and engine flow. Failing to reflect any missiles will result in the vengeance core overloading, massively increasing damage received by shields and doubling shield radius as well as disrupting its engine flow.

Does not work with Shield Shunt.

name: Vengeance Receiver
desc: Audacious-class destroyers have subsystems relays that can synchronize with Vengeance-class cruisers to temporarily increase combat performance. However, these subsystem relays interfere with its fighter uplink system.

name: Cramped Hull
desc: Due to the sheer amount of heavy armor plating and complicated subsystems within the Indomitable's hull, it cannot support the full complement of missile weapons that its structure technically allows.

name: Cramped Hull
desc: Due to design conflicts between the Renown's drone microforges and ordinance storage, it cannot effectively support the full complement of missile weapons that its structure technically allows.

name: Heavy Weapon Integration
desc: Reduces the ordnance point cost of large ballistic and energy weapons by %s.

name: Aquila Reactor Protocol
desc: Subsystems are fine-tuned for speed and active venting efficiency. Causes interference with modifications that affect weapon range, preventing their range boosting capabilities.
short: Drastic improvement in speed, maneuverability, and active venting speed, lower peak time.

name: Avaritia Capacity Overhaul
desc: Overhauls the vessel's flux venting system to be used in rapid short bursts. Due to the system's experimental nature, active venting accumulates a huge amount of flux when the capacitors lack sufficient charge.
short: Drastic improvement in venting and firepower.
sModDesc: Increases the flux dissipation rate while venting by %s.

name: Vanagloria Ionized Armor
desc: Modular damper systems are installed within the ship's armor, allowing limited use of an experimental damper field on vessels that could otherwise not support such a system. This damper system differs in its ability to freely use weapon systems when used.
short: Drastic improvement in absorbing high on-hit and absorbing blows.

name: Gula-Pattern Warheads
desc: Missile fuel mix optimizations allow for higher top speeds and rapid loading. The increased output is too unstable for vector thrusters, limiting usage to unguided torpedoes.
short: Boosts reload speed and rate of fire of unguided missiles.
sModDesc: Applies bonuses to all fighter missile weapons, regardless of guidance. The Missile Microforge hullmod works %s faster.
